pages.text: The $(item)Electric Drill$() is a pickaxe and shovel in one (diamond level), using 50 FE per block instead of durability. Shift-right-click switches between 1x1 and 3x3 mining; hold Shift while mining for a single block.
The $(item)Electric Chainsaw$() cuts wood, leaves, wool and cobwebs. Both hold 100,000 FE; charge them in a Charger.
